output.reason: [ev-ae9158566d1b] is a one-line changelog entry under Enhancements saying only "Add support for Brotli" in middleware. It doesn't name the middleware. It also doesn't say whether Brotli is opt-in or becomes active by default for existing configurations, for example by changing the encoding returned to clients that accept Brotli. If it is on by default, the consequence would be behavior-change rather than none, so the evidence can't confirm "none". To decide, we need the PR #9387 description or the v3.0.0 middleware documentation/migration notes stating the default encoding behavior.
